root_cause.text: The .negotiate_features callback was added to the common mac_operations structure but was not populated in the Hyper-V specific ops table (ixgbevf_hv_mac_ops), causing a NULL pointer dereference when ixgbevf_negotiate_api() unconditionally calls hw->mac.ops.negotiate_features() on Hyper-V VMs.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states "forgot to add it to ixgbevf_hv_mac_ops" and the crash trace shows a NULL pointer dereference at the negotiate_features call during probe. The patch adds `ixgbevf_hv_negotiate_features_vf` and wires it into `ixgbevf_hv_mac_ops`.
